overview

sections · 0.2.0 · aj-s-overview

The overview at the top of the writing companion on Today (v4 C4): one row, ruled off below, no title. The latest weekly reflection's line in the glance's face and size, never wrapping, and a chevron after it; the line and the chevron are the link to that reflection. A line longer than its row fades into the chevron. It must not look like the person's own writing.

statedefaultyes: the line with a faint dotted underline and the chevron after its last word; a long line fades into the chevron
statehoveryes: (fine pointer) the chevron leans --g-lean-x toward where it leads and the underline turns solid; reduced motion darkens the chevron to --ink instead
statefocus-visibleyes: the product's ring, with the hover's lean and solid underline
stateactiveyes: a new reflection's first showing nudges the chevron once (data-new, set by the script from the seen record)
statedisabledn/a: shown only when there is a line to open
stateselectedn/a: not selectable
stateloadingn/a: written with the page
stateerrorn/a: absent rather than wrong
stateemptyn/a: no line, no overview (renders nothing; the composer is then the plain form)

Default

The week's line and the chevron after it, ruled off below (01-today).

First week

A new account before its first reflection: Today's first-week line, opening the week so far.

Your first reflection comes on Sunday.

One word

Stress test only: the chevron right after a one-word line.

Quiet.

Long

Stress test only: a line longer than a phone's row fades into the chevron (with the script; an ellipsis without).

Five days here, sleep on your mind for most of them, and the flat viewing on Tuesday never far from it.

Names

Stress test only: long names with diacritics, as a reflection can name people.

Aleksandra Wiśniewska-Kowalczyk’s birthday, and Bartholomew’s news.

Non-Latin

Stress test only: Russian and Japanese, not product copy.

Hover

The chevron leans 4px and the underline turns solid under a mouse; drawn at rest here, hover it to see.
